subject: Medford Street Broadway Development ZBA Notification
overview: The Medford City Council approved funding for a new DPW sewer maintenance truck and addressed extensive resident concerns regarding public notice and participation at Zoning Board of Appeals hearings for a Medford Street development.

items.title: DPW Sewer Truck Purchase
items.summary: Approved funding to purchase a replacement sewer and catch basin cleaning truck for the Department of Public Works.

items.title: Resolution 17-727: ZBA Notification List Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a list of addresses notified by the city for the Zoning Board of Appeals meeting concerning the Medford Street Broadway proposal.

items.title: Resolution 17-728: ZBA Meeting Schedule Conflicts
items.summary: Voted to send a proposal prohibiting ZBA meetings from conflicting with City Council meetings to the City Solicitor to draft ordinance language.

items.title: Resolution 17-729: Scaled Abutter Map Request
items.summary: Approved a request for a scaled map detailing which abutters were notified of the ZBA hearing on the Medford Street project.

items.title: Resolution 17-730: Requesting ZBA Public Testimony
items.summary: Adopted a resolution requesting that the mayor ask the ZBA to allow public comment at its next and subsequent meetings.

items.title: Resolution 17-731: Variance Notification Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance requiring notice to all property owners within 300 feet of a variance request to the City Solicitor for legal review within 30 days.

items.title: Routine Infrastructure and Traffic Motions
items.summary: Approved routine resolutions concerning streetlight repairs, sidewalk safety hazard reviews, tree trimming, street sweeping, traffic sign additions, and removing unused railroad tracks.

items.title: Drainage Construction and Rodent Abatement Discussions
items.summary: Approved motions requesting improved outreach and a neighborhood meeting for upcoming drainage construction, as well as an action plan for rat infestations in Wellington and North Medford.

items.title: Petition 17-732: ZBA Hearing and Medford Street Development
items.summary: Heard testimony from residents excluded from speaking at the ZBA meeting and passed a motion asking the mayor to arrange a developer-neighborhood meeting and requesting the ZBA delay deliberations to allow public comment.
